issue.title: sase-core flake: tool_run store private_argv_is_not_serialized_on_queries fails once under full parallel lane, passes alone
issue.description:
Proposed by epic phase sase-17m.2.1.2 (sase-core additive agent-session rename, scan-runtime) as a "flake watch" PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP; filed by the sase-17m.2.1 land agent. Not caused by sase-17m.2.1: that phase touched no tool_run files.

Observation: `tool_run::store::tests::private_argv_is_not_serialized_on_queries` (crates/sase_core/src/tool_run/store/tests.rs:1051) failed once under the full parallel test lane of `sase tool run check` in sase-core (tree at the scan-runtime phase, ~ef82848) and passed when run alone on the same tree. Fail rate: 1 of 1 full-lane runs observed by that phase, 0 failures in isolation. The failure output was not retained, so the root cause is unknown; next reporter should capture the assertion text.
